set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

parameters.name: vlan-name
parameters.explanation: VLAN's name, like Vlan100.

vlan-id [parameter2].explanation: Configure VLAN with specific VLAN ID

parameters.name: vlan id
parameters.explanation: ID of the VLAN

set interfaces [interface_name].explanation: The command `set interfaces [interface_name]` in Junos OS creates or configures a specific network interface, allowing further settings like IP addresses or VLANs to be applied.

parameters.name: interface_name
parameters.explanation: The name of the interface to be configured

unit [unit_number] family [family_type].explanation: Configures the port mode for a specified interface unit under the ethernet-switching family

parameters.name: unit_number
parameters.explanation: The unit number of the interface

parameters.name: family_type
parameters.explanation: The family type under which the interface is configured

parameters.name: port_mode
parameters.explanation: The mode in which the port operates, e.g., access
